clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, her distance from Walter as he worked long hours, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that winter, Walter and June's rows over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir with her anxiety easing and functioning rising by September 1953. Glen's stomach aches are told as beginning that first winter with no date anyone confirms, so they stay out. Every shift in these months is these three people's, and no one else's shows then.

clusters.name: the orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the year: Walter's drinking heavily most nights, Walter and Glen blaming each other over the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worse that winter, Nora wetting the bed again by spring, Ida's heart trouble found in May 1969, and Walter stopping drinking and taking work pruning other men's trees by October 1969. Roy's cutoff from Walter is told with no date anyone agrees on, so it stays out. Carl's asthma easing once spring came is a lift alongside his mother's symptom rising, so it counts with the period; Nora's bed-wetting opened with the family's move and the crisis together.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from her mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976. Glen's spending nights at his girlfriend's house is told with no date anyone is sure of, so it stays out; Tess's nightmares are told as beginning January 1976 with no date anyone confirms, so they stay out.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within sixteen months: Nora clashing with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Nora distancing from Hollis as she kept out of the kitchen rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool and sent home twice, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, Nora and Hollis rowing most nights, and Nora's eczema clearing over the summer of 1991. Marian driving over twice a week to take Nora's side is told with no date anyone is sure of, so it stays out. Wilma's move to a flat in town in June 1991 is where the period settles.
